name: devloop
description: AI-native SDLC loop as committed artifacts, for coding agents.

interface.longDescription: Shared development workflow skills for Claude Code and Codex. Start work resolves an issue or task, prepares a branch and plan, and begins implementation. Deep review examines PRs and branches for correctness and accidental complexity, then proposes minimal fixes without editing files.
defaultPrompt: Use start-work to begin implementing a task.
Use deep-review to review the current branch.
